description: Recent news articles by keyword with title, url, source, published_at and snippet, from Hacker News (tech) and BBC feeds (general, world, business, science, health, politics). Use for current events and topic monitoring. For crypto news use crypto-news, for what people say about a topic discussion-search, and for full article text pass the URLs to web-read-batch. Params: query (required), limit (max 30), category. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"AI agents","limit":5}.

category.description: News category filter. 'tech' searches HackerNews for developer/tech news. Others search BBC + general news feeds.

limit.description: Number of articles to return (default: 10, max: 30)

name: news_search
